name: smwsprites-expanded-dino-rhino-dino-torch
title: Expanded Dino Rhino + Dino Torch
description:
This is an expansion of the Dino Rhino and the Dino Torch, sprites 6E and 6F of Super Mario World. An extra bit of 2 will make this a Dino Rhino, and an extra bit of 3 will make this a Dino Torch.

This variant includes some code optimizations from the original, as well as changes, such as:
* The Dino Rhino can now spit two kinds of flame, or spit nothing.
* The Dino Torch can be made to spit nothing.
* The Dino Rhino can turn into a Dino Torch or die instantly.
* The pattern can be random or fixed.
